homeHint: Create and manage your Bots, or open their tasks. Choose a Bot in the sidebar to start talking.
emptyHint: Choose a name and personality, then start talking or give your Bot work to do.
retainedHint: Task counts cover retained records. Chat and channel history are separate.
chatHint: One ongoing conversation with this Bot. Background tasks have their own context.
clearHint: All messages and chat context will be cleared, including any reply in progress. The Bot’s personality, tasks, channels and saved creations will remain.
chatEmpty: Say hello. This is your ongoing conversation with this Bot.
clearedElsewhere: The conversation was cleared. Previous messages and the draft have been removed.
chatBusy: This Bot is replying. You can prepare your next message below.
staleConversation: This conversation was cleared. Review the refreshed history before sending again.
idempotencyConflict: This request has already been used. Refresh before trying again.
invalidInput: Check your input and try again.
conflict: The Bot was updated. Refresh and try again.
cleanupPending: Conversation cleared. The previous engine history is being removed.
cleanupBlocked: The conversation is cleared, but removing the previous engine history needs attention. New replies cannot use that history.
failureInterrupted: The reply was interrupted. Your message is saved; you can try again.
failureRateLimited: The model is busy. Try again in a little while.
failureAuthentication: The model connection needs attention in settings.
failureUnavailable: The model is unavailable. Your message is saved.
failureFailed: The reply could not be completed. You can try again.
resolveSend: The previous send has not been confirmed. Retry the original message or clear the conversation before sending different text.
integrationHint: Connect sources, let your Bot process them, and read the results here.
connectionHint: Credentials stay encrypted on the server. Reuse a connection across your Bots.
credentialHint: When editing, leave all credential fields blank to keep existing credentials.
providerHelp: Slack: grant chat:write and invite the Bot to the chosen channel. Gmail: enable the Gmail API and authorize gmail.readonly and gmail.send with offline access.
sourceHint: Only new inbox messages after setup are collected. Original emails and attachments are not changed.
internalChannel: Keep results in this private channel
retentionHint: Default 30 days, from 1 to 365. Expiry removes this integration’s retained results, source captures and delivery details, not saved creations or provider originals.
dailyLimit: Automatic replies per mailbox per UTC day
autoConsent: I authorize automatic replies only to the listed senders within this limit. Other messages stay as drafts.
previewHint: Preview only reads sources. It does not advance collection, create model tasks or send messages.
runConfirm: This run processes new source items and uses the saved delivery settings, including Slack or automatic replies if enabled.
noIntegrations: Add an RSS feed or mailbox to give this Bot recurring work.
replyConfirm: Send this reply to the shown sender in the original email thread?
deliveryDispatching: Sending; cancellation may not stop this delivery
deliveryUnknown: Outcome unknown; do not send again until verified
connectionSaved: Connection saved. Test it before use.
integrationError: The operation could not finish. Your inputs are kept; refresh the status before retrying an uncertain send.
integrationInvalid: Check the source, schedule, connections and delivery settings.
integrationBusy: This integration is still running. Open its run history to manage it.
integrationStale: The settings changed. Refresh to review the latest version; your unsaved inputs remain here.
connectionUnavailable: Test an enabled connection before using it. If credentials were changed, verify the intended account again.
quotaReached: The automatic reply limit was reached. Review this draft before sending manually.
alreadyReplied: A reply to this message is already reserved or sent. Verify its receipt before continuing.
sourceError: Could not read the source. Check its URL or account permissions and try a preview again.
previewLimited: Only the bounded first batch is shown. For very large sources, use a narrower feed or inbox filter.
messagePlaceholder: Write a message… Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line
copyTooLarge: This conversation is too large to copy at once. Copy individual replies instead.
